sections.note: The disposable board 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-04 Delegation board' was created through Settings > Ticketing > Boards in failed attempt attempts/a1-failed-seat-limit and reused here. White Rabbit's only seat is used by Alice, so QA raised the allocation 1 -> 2 through Change seat allocation before Alice created the non-administrator user.
Unassigned Oz staff (Tin Woodman) is not offered as a principal. Grant row binds QA, board_settings and the disposable board only.

The editor offers exactly board name, description and live-ticket-timer. Alice saw the delegated description in her own board settings; QA restored the original description through the approved editor and it persisted after reload.

sections.section: 3. Prove revocation closes an open editor
sections.note: Alice revoked the approval in a second session while QA's editor stayed open. QA's stale save was refused and the board kept its original description. Retry same request did not bring the approval back. After Refresh access the record is no longer offered. Observation: the stale save shows the generic 'request could not be confirmed' text with a Retry button. It does not say the approval was revoked.

sections.section: 4. Review the other bounded operations: non-administrator profile
sections.note: Alice (administrator) is not an eligible target. QA changed the first name, and Alice saw it in Settings > Users after reload. QA then restored the original name. The time-zone field was offered but not changed.

sections.section: 4. Review the other bounded operations: resend customer-created invitation
sections.note: QA saw the recipient, Technician role and expiry. A second message reached the controlled SMTP sink. The invitation row (email, role, token, expiry 2026-10-27T03:37:05Z, metadata) was byte-identical before and after the resend, and the delivered setup link matched the original (sha256 recorded).

All three review approvals were revoked. To return the allocation to 1, the profile user was deactivated and the review invitation was revoked through Settings > Users, then QA restored White Rabbit's allocation from 2 to 1.
